svg.title: The grid stack
svg.desc: The grid stack, three open-source repositories. 01 Measure: nabd, GPS-disciplined ESP32-S3 nodes that measure frequency, ROCOF and IEEE C37.118 synchrophasors for about 59 US dollars per node (pre-release). 02 Simulate: swingbus, power flow, N-1 and DC optimal power flow with LMPs; matches PYPOWER to 1e-13 pu and screens all of IEEE 118 for N-1 in 8.3 ms; 95 tests on three operating systems. 03 Predict: cascade-gnn, five graph neural networks against XGBoost with edge attributions checked against the simulated cascade; 14 tests and a claim ledger. swingbus generates the cascade datasets cascade-gnn learns from. Animations are illustrations.

g.text: From a wall socket to a warning.
